name: shesha-developer-0-46
description: Version-pinned design and form pipeline for the v0.46 release of the Shesha framework: shesha-claude-designer (orchestrator), shesha-design-comprehension (measured layout blueprints + placement verification), shesha-design-system (theming on Ant Design 6), shesha-form-edit (structure/CRUD against the 0.46 form API, render-migration hazards, reworked components and scripting API), clean-form-config and create-crud-form, plus the form-author, form-auditor, fleet-transformer, design-critic and fullstack-prereq-checker agents. Component knowledge is extracted from release-0.46.0.
